mapper.select: select id from t_user order by id
select id, openid, phone, nickname, gender, age, height, weight, target, bmr, created_at, updated_at from t_user where openid = #{openid} limit 1
select id, openid, phone, password, nickname, gender, age, height, weight, target, bmr, created_at, updated_at from t_user where phone = #{phone} limit 1
select id, openid, phone, nickname, gender, age, height, weight, target, bmr, created_at, updated_at from t_user where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_user (openid, phone, password, nickname, gender, age, height, weight, target, bmr, created_at, updated_at) values (#{openid}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{target}, #{bmr}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update t_user set gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, target = #{target}, bmr = #{bmr}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
